boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Iowa
boards.description: Ten currently documented food stops in Iowa City with late service windows; confirm availability before leaving.

cards.title: Falbo Bros Pizza
cards.subtitle: 457 S Gilbert St, Iowa City
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page to check the day’s status, then plan a pickup from this Gilbert Street pizza counter.
cards.short_summary: Pizza pickup with posted service through 2 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Falbo Bros Pizza lists its Iowa City address as 457 S Gilbert St and posts hours of 11 AM–2 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official site posts hours of 11:00 AM–2:00 AM; verify before travel.

cards.title: Gumby's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 702 S Gilbert St, Suite 103, Iowa City
cards.notes: Check the official schedule before heading south of downtown; it lists late-night delivery and an Iowa City storefront.
cards.short_summary: Pizza and wings with late posted delivery hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Gumby's official Iowa City page lists 702 S Gilbert St, Suite 103 and service until 2:45 AM Monday–Saturday, 1:45 AM Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Mon–Fri 2 PM–2:45 AM; Sat 11 AM–2:45 AM; Sun 11 AM–1:45 AM.

cards.title: Pancheros Downtown
cards.subtitle: 32 S Clinton St, Iowa City
cards.notes: Use the location’s order options for a downtown pickup, and consult its official page for the applicable late closing time.
cards.short_summary: Downtown burrito stop with service as late as 3 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Pancheros lists its downtown Iowa City location at 32 S Clinton St, with closing at 2 AM Sunday–Wednesday and 3 AM Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: 10:30 AM–2 AM Sun–Wed and 10:30 AM–3 AM Thu–Sat.

cards.entity_name: Papa Johns Pizza — S Gilbert St
cards.title: Papa Johns on S Gilbert
cards.subtitle: 307 S Gilbert St, Iowa City
cards.notes: Choose carryout or delivery from this Gilbert Street location, checking the posted schedule for the day before ordering.
cards.short_summary: Carryout or delivery pizza with 1–2 AM closing windows.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists 307 S Gilbert St in Iowa City and Friday–Saturday delivery until 2 AM, with carryout until 1:45 AM.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns Pizza — 307 S Gilbert St
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Fri–Sat delivery until 2 AM and carryout until 1:45 AM; other days vary.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on South 1st
cards.subtitle: 805 South 1st Avenue #2, Iowa City
cards.notes: Use the location page to choose delivery or carryout, especially when its Friday and Saturday schedule extends later.
cards.short_summary: Chain pizza pickup or delivery with 1 AM weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists its Iowa City location at 805 South 1st Avenue #2 and posted restaurant hours until 1 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours list 9 AM–1 AM Friday and Saturday; midnight closing Sunday–Thursday.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Highway 6
cards.subtitle: 901 Highway 6 E, Iowa City
cards.notes: This drive-through location is an option when you have transportation; use the official locator to confirm the selected service mode.
cards.short_summary: Drive-through food with posted service as late as 4 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists its Iowa City location at 901 Highway 6 E, with drive-through hours until 4 AM Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official drive-through hours: until 2 AM Sun–Wed, 3 AM Thu, and 4 AM Fri–Sat.

cards.title: Domino's on South Gilbert
cards.subtitle: 1534 S Gilbert St, Iowa City
cards.notes: Order online or call ahead for delivery or takeout, then confirm the live closing time on the location page.
cards.short_summary: South Iowa City pizza location that posts a 1 AM close.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official location page identifies the store at 1534 S Gilbert St in Iowa City and states it is open until 1 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official location page displayed “Open Today Until 1:00 AM”; live hours can vary by day.

cards.entity_name: Luna's Tacos Family Kitchen Food Truck
cards.title: Luna's Tacos Food Truck
cards.subtitle: Iowa City Ped Mall, across from Aspen Leaf
cards.notes: Find the seasonal Ped Mall truck only during its listed February–December run, and confirm the nightly setup before going.
cards.short_summary: Seasonal Ped Mall food truck with a 2:30 AM posted close.
cards.evidence_claim: Luna's Tacos lists its food truck in the Iowa City Ped Mall, across from Aspen Leaf, operating February–December from 9 PM–2:30 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists the food truck February–December, 9 PM–2:30 AM; its restaurant has different hours.

cards.title: Uncle Sun
cards.subtitle: 100 S Linn St, Iowa City
cards.notes: Check the day-specific schedule before making this Linn Street pickup; late service is listed only Wednesday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: Chinese-food pickup with 2 AM service on select nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Uncle Sun lists its Iowa City location at 100 S Linn St and posts 5 PM–2 AM hours Wednesday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: 5 PM–2 AM Wednesday–Saturday; midnight Monday and Sunday; closed Tuesday.

cards.title: Marco's Grilled Cheese
cards.subtitle: 117 N Linn St, Iowa City
cards.notes: Use the North Linn Street address and plan for the late Thursday–Saturday window posted by the downtown district.
cards.short_summary: Northside grilled-cheese restaurant with 2 AM weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Iowa City Downtown District lists Marco's Grilled Cheese at 117 N Linn St and hours until 2 AM Thursday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Iowa City Downtown District — Marco's Grilled Cheese
cards.access_notes: Downtown District lists 11 AM–2 AM Thursday–Saturday; Monday–Wednesday until 11 PM and Sunday until 9 PM.
